fields.description: Issue features local political commentary on changes in Miami city government, including the resignation of Edward Coleman Romfh and the appointment of Harry Platt as city manager and Gordon H. Russell as city commissioner, with discussion of City Hall politics and civic administration. Additional columns and briefs address municipal operations and publicity efforts, local legal and law-enforcement matters, transportation and traffic safety concerns in Miami Beach, and community society and entertainment notices and advertisements.
